dont.t: 只是“保存成功”等瞬时反馈：使用 {c:toast}

持续提示过多：重要程度与阅读顺序会变得模糊
将营销广告伪装成警告：会削弱用户对提示的信任

lessonPractice.title: 账号将在 7 天后到期，用户仍可继续编辑设置，但需要持续看到续费提醒。怎样呈现？

options.label: 在设置内容附近保留一条说明影响和续费入口的警告
options.feedback: 这条信息需要持续可见，但不必阻断编辑；就近警告能同时说明风险和下一步。

options.label: 进入页面时弹出两秒轻提示，然后自动消失
options.feedback: 到期提醒需要用户记住并可能稍后处理，短暂消失的轻提示很容易被错过。

options.label: 每次进入设置都弹窗，续费前不允许关闭
options.feedback: 用户仍可继续使用和编辑，强制阻断超过了当前风险；持续但不阻断的提醒更合适。

en.title: An account expires in seven days. People may keep editing settings, but the renewal reminder must remain visible. How should it appear?

options.label: Keep an alert near the settings with the impact and a renewal action
options.feedback: The message remains visible without blocking editing and gives both the risk and a clear next step.

options.label: Show a two-second toast when the page opens and then dismiss it
options.feedback: An expiry reminder may require later action, so a brief disappearing message is too easy to miss.

options.label: Open a modal on every visit and prevent closing it until renewal
options.feedback: The account still works, so blocking the entire settings task overstates the current restriction.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请在账号设置附近增加持续可见的到期警告，说明剩余天数、影响和续费入口，但不要阻断编辑。不要只靠黄色表达重要性。请验证警告可读、续费入口可用，关闭后按产品规则处理。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Add a persistent expiry alert near account settings with remaining days, impact, and a renewal action without blocking editing. Do not rely on yellow alone. Verify readability, the renewal action, and the product's intended dismissal behavior.
